resolutions.phrase: The eighteen-month retention for Quillmoor field recordings, set on the 1 October planning call

referents.why: Odette Varga's statement set raw field recordings at eighteen months. The commentary replaces that figure with twelve. The transcripts clause in the same statement is untouched.

resolutions.why: The 1 October planning call, Quillmoor and the eighteen-month figure converge on one expression, the archive retention rule. It sits in the only position in the graph that holds the call's settled items.

referents.why: It restates the second sentence of the retention rule ('Transcripts we keep permanently') and says it stays in force, which clarifies the scope of the change.

resolutions.why: The permanent-transcripts rule exists only in the archive retention expression from the 1 October call.
